<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="337" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="14" x2="346" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="11" x2="355" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="368" y1="17" x2="371" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="375" y="9" width="15" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="377" y="11" width="10" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="390" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,55 22,64 31,73" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="64" x2="43" y2="64" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="349" y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="0.4" fill="#939393">SKIP</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Brand mark -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="126" r="28" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <path d="M195 108 C185 116 183 124 187 130 C190 135 196 137 200 133 C204 130 204 124 200 119 C199 116 197 112 195 108 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <path d="M195 119 C191 124 191 128 194 130 C196 132 199 131 200 128 C201 125 199 122 195 119 Z" fill="#FF7854"/>
    <text x="195" y="174" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="2.2" fill="#4A4A4A">TINDER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main copy -->
  <text x="195" y="232" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Sign in with Apple</text>
  <text x="195" y="266" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#939393">Link your Apple ID to Tinder for a</text>
  <text x="195" y="289" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#939393">faster, easier way to sign in.</text>

  <!-- Apple sign-in button shadow -->
  <rect x="40" y="325" width="310" height="52" rx="26" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <!-- Apple sign-in button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="322" width="310" height="52" rx="26" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <path d="M104 344 C100 339 94 341 92 345 C90 349 91 357 96 361 C100 365 104 361 106 357 C108 353 108 348 104 344 Z" fill="#000000"/>
    <path d="M101 340 C103 338 106 337 108 338 C107 341 105 343 102 343 Z" fill="#000000"/>
    <path d="M110 347 C113 349 114 353 113 356 C112 358 110 360 108 361 C107 357 107 352 110 347 Z" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="205" y="354" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">SIGN IN WITH APPLE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Privacy reassurance -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="67" cy="430" r="22" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <rect x="60" y="428" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="63" y="422" width="8" height="9" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="104" y="426" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Your privacy matters</text>
    <text x="104" y="447" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Apple keeps your personal details private.</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="40" y1="483" x2="350" y2="483" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Information rows -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="67" cy="526" r="22" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="67" cy="521" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="67" cy="534" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="104" y="522" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">One-tap access</text>
    <text x="104" y="543" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Use Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode.</text>

    <circle cx="67" cy="601" r="22" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <polyline points="58,601 64,607 77,593" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="104" y="597" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">No new password needed</text>
    <text x="104" y="618" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Your Apple ID securely verifies your account.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Fine print -->
  <text x="195" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Light Light, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">By continuing, you agree to Tinder's Terms and Privacy Policy.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="1" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,770 48,762 58,770 58,783 51,783 51,775 45,775 45,783 38,783" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="48" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">HOME</text>

    <path d="M117 766 C114 762 107 764 107 770 C107 776 117 782 117 782 C117 782 127 776 127 770 C127 764 120 762 117 766 Z" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="117" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>

    <circle cx="195" cy="771" r="9" fill="none" stroke="url(#tinderGradient)" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="191,771 194,774 200,767" fill="none" stroke="url(#tinderGradient)" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FE3675">MATCHES</text>

    <circle cx="273" cy="767" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="273" cy="780" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="273" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>

    <circle cx="342" cy="771" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="771" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="764" x2="342" y2="778" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="771" x2="349" y2="771" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="342" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">SETTINGS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="828" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
